name: Comic World (Seoul)
blurb: Long-running Korean doujinshi fair held roughly monthly at KINTEX near Seoul, one city of the touring multi-city Comic World series.

editions.evidence: Homepage event ticker: '진행중코믹월드 339 일산#11코일산 기간 : 2026-11-07 ~ 2026-11-08 장소 : 일산 키택스 제1전시장' (Comic World 339 Ilsan, period 2026-11-07~2026-11-08, venue Ilsan KINTEX Exhibition Hall 1).
Homepage event ticker: '준뱄중코믹월드 WINTER 2026#12코일산 기간 : 2026-12-12 ~ 2026-12-13 장소 : 일산 키택스 제1전시장' (Comic World WINTER 2026, Ilsan, period 2026-12-12~2026-12-13, same venue).

notes: comicw.co.kr (seed URL) redirects to comicw.net, the current official domain; one shared portal lists every city's Comic World dates (Suwon, Ilsan/KINTEX = Seoul area, Busan, Ulsan...) under one sequential event-number series. This file covers the Ilsan/KINTEX (Seoul-area) edition only, matching the seed note's 'held roughly monthly at KINTEX'. Comic World is a fan-made doujinshi/circle market, not a guest-celebrity convention (no guest menu or guest program on the site), so guests is 'none' for every edition. No official og/twitter/banner image is Seoul/Ilsan-specific right now (current homepage banners all promote the Suwon edition or an unrelated stationery expo), so the cover uses the site's own logo rather than another city's artwork.
